reason: A conversational persona plugin centered on configurable roleplay behavior and persistent cross-session memory, with proactive clarification and memory-based context injection.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的角色扮演女仆人格、主动对话模式以及基于交互记录的长期记忆。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a configurable roleplay maid persona, proactive conversation modes, and long-term memory based on interaction records.

capabilities: Provides an in-character conversational maid persona
Supports proactive and passive speaking modes
Uses ask_user_question for vague or incomplete tasks
Persists stable user facts and interaction logs in a plain-text memory file
Injects recent and related memories into model context
Provides Web UI configuration for identity, mode, and memory path
